users.search: Search by name, login or email

account.title: New account
account.name: Name
account.hint: Give the login and password to the employee yourself — they'll change the password on the “My access” page.

reset.title: New password for {name}
reset.done: Password reset — give the new one to the employee

page.blockBody: The employee's sessions end at once, and running agents stop at their next step. Chats and data are kept.
page.grantBody: The employee will be able to manage accounts, roles, permissions, sign-in methods, MCP servers and models.

roles.name: Role name
roles.removeBody: The role's employees lose its permissions at once.
roles.grantAdminTitle: Give the “{role}” role the admin permission?
roles.grantAdminBody: {members, plural, =0 {The role has no employees now; anyone added to it will become an admin.} other {Every employee of the role will become an admin: {members}.}}

kind.keyNeededHint: Without a key, this provider's models don't work.

gemini.label: Google Gemini
gemini.baseUrlHint: Empty — the official Gemini API address.

openai_compatible.label: OpenAI-compatible
openai_compatible.hint: OpenAI, vLLM, a corporate gateway — any server with an OpenAI-format API.
openai_compatible.baseUrlHint: The server's API address, for example http://vllm.corp:8000/v1. Empty — the OpenAI address.
openai_compatible.apiKeyHint: Leave empty if the server needs no key.

chat.label: Chat model
chat.hint: The chat and the system agents run on it, and every new agent gets it. Agents with their own model stay on theirs.
chat.notChosen: Until a chat model is chosen, the chat doesn't answer employees.
chat.consequence: Until then, the chat doesn't answer.
chat.nothingToChoose: The catalog has no working chat models — add a model below.

embedding.label: Embedding model
embedding.hint: Self-learning uses it to pick knowledge close in meaning to the question. After a change, knowledge takes a while to get ready for picking again.
embedding.notChosen: Until an embedding model is chosen, picking by meaning in self-learning is off.
embedding.consequence: Until then, picking by meaning in self-learning is off.
embedding.nothingToChoose: The catalog has no working embedding models — add a model with the “Embeddings” purpose below.

defaults.notWorking: The {model} model doesn't work now: {reason, select, provider_disabled {provider {provider} is off} provider_missing {provider {provider} is gone} other {provider {provider} has no key}}.

providers.keyNeededName: no key set, models don't work
providers.emptyDescription: Add a provider to connect its models: Anthropic, Google Gemini or an OpenAI-compatible server.
providers.offChat: {model} is the default chat model: while the provider is off, the chat doesn't answer employees.
providers.offEmbedding: {model} is the default embedding model: while the provider is off, picking by meaning in self-learning is off.
providers.cannotRemoveBody: Models of this provider in the catalog: {count}. Remove them from the catalog first.
providers.removeBody: The provider's key is deleted with it. This can't be undone.
providers.checkNoConnection: Couldn't check: no connection to the server

providerDialog.name: Name
providerDialog.nameHint: The first part of its models' IDs: {name}/'<model>'. The name can't change once added.
providerDialog.fixedHint: The name and type don't change. Need others? Add a new provider.

dialog.modelNameHint: What the model is called in the provider's API, for example gemini-2.5-flash.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.dimensionsHint: How many numbers are in a vector, for example 768. Can't change once added.

catalog.newPrices: New prices apply to the next calls. Past costs aren't recalculated.
catalog.removeTitle: Remove the “{name}” model from the catalog?
catalog.removeBody: All permissions and personal blocks on this model will be deleted. Agents can no longer choose it, and those running on it will fail with “model not connected”.
catalog.defaultChat: This is the default chat model: until you choose another, the chat doesn't answer.
catalog.defaultEmbedding: This is the default embedding model: until you choose another, picking by meaning in self-learning is off.
catalog.emptyDescription: Add a model so agents can work.
catalog.emptyNoProviders: Add a provider first, then its models.

library.author: Author
library.banLifted: Block lifted: the author can share again
library.sharedEmpty: Employees haven't shared anything with roles yet
library.closeBody: The {kind, select, agent {agent} other {workflow}} becomes private to its author, {author}: {roleCount, plural, one {the {roles} role will no longer see it} other {the roles {roles} will no longer see it}}. The author can't share it again until you lift the block. Runs already in progress will finish.

settings.title: New record settings
settings.defaultMaxTurns: Step limit for a new record
settings.hint: This number fills in “Maximum steps” of a new agent or workflow. Each record can change it; records already created stay as they are.

knowledge.title: Workflow self-learning
knowledge.limitTokens: Room for knowledge in a run, tokens
knowledge.limitTokensHint: How much knowledge each step of a run gets: up to half goes to the records closest in meaning to the question, the rest to the most confirmed ones.
knowledge.lessonsEnabledHint: Turn this off if lessons don't shorten the search. Lessons stay in each workflow's knowledge, and runs get facts and “searched — found nothing” as usual.

servers.emptyHint: Register your first MCP server by its address.

modeHint.shared: One token for everyone: every call goes with it.
modeHint.oauth: Each employee connects their own account. To get the tool list, connect yours.

registration.title: Registration
registration.name: Name
registration.nameHint: Agent definitions point to the server by this name. The name can't change after registration.

page.readOnlyHint: To change the address or mode, delete the server and register it again.
page.removeBody: Agents lose its tools at once. This can't be undone. Employees' connected accounts on this server will be deleted.

connectReturn.connect_failed: Couldn't connect your account: the sign-in was canceled or not finished. Try again.
connectReturn.tools_failed: Account connected, but the tool list couldn't be fetched. Click “Refresh list”.

toolResults.title: Large tool results
toolResults.storeFromChars: Replace an answer with a reference if it's longer than, characters
toolResults.storeFromCharsHint: An MCP tool answer longer than this reaches the agent as a reference with the answer's beginning, and the agent reads the rest in parts.
toolResults.previewChars: Answer beginning in the reference, characters
toolResults.previewCharsHint: How many first characters of the answer the agent sees at once. Less than the length at which the answer is replaced with a reference.
toolResults.readMaxTokens: Agent reads at a time, tokens
toolResults.readMaxTokensHint: How much the agent gets for one read or one search through the saved answer.

signIn.googleWarning: An enabled Google provider lets in anyone with a Google account: the first sign-in creates an account without roles. Until you give it permissions, the chat doesn't answer it.
signIn.name: Button name

newProvider.title: New provider
newProvider.oidcHint: Okta or any corporate IdP over OIDC

provider.providerDataHint: Copy these values into the Agent OS app settings at the provider

settings.title: Sign-in settings
settings.absoluteHint: From 1 to 720 hours (30 days), no less than the inactivity limit.
settings.note: New limits also apply to employees already signed in — from their next request. Copy the new address into “Data for the provider” of each provider.
